texts.preamble: Rajaraddy S/O Subbaraddy vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 28 March, 2024 Author: V Srishananda Bench: V Srishananda -1- Nc: 2024:Khc-K:2641 Wp No. 204612 of 2019 In The High Court Of Karnataka Kalaburagi Bench Dated This The 28Th Day Of March, 2024 Before The Hon'Ble Mr Justice V Srishananda Writ Petition No.204612/2019(Gm-Res) Between: Rajaraddy S/O Subbaraddy Age: 35 Years, Occ: Business, President, Sujata Patil Sudda Kudiva Nirina Vitarana Sangh, Shomakaradoddi, R/O Shomakaradoddi, Jalahalli Road, Tq: Devadurga, Dist: Raichur-584121. ...Petitioner (By Sri Sudhirsingh R. Vijapur, Advocate) Digitally signed And: by Renuka Location: High Court Of 1. The State Of Karnataka Karnataka Represented By Its Secretary, Department Of Food & Civil Supplies, M.S. Building, Vidhana Veedhi, Bangalore-1. Rajaraddy S/O Subbaraddy vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 28 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81668359/ 1 2. The Deputy Commissioner D.C., Office, Raichur, Dist: Raichur-584101. -2- Nc: 2024:Khc-K:2641 Wp No. 204612 of 2019 3. The Commissioner, Raichur Municipal Council, Dist: Raichur-584101. 4. The Designated Officer, Food Safety And Standards Department, District Health And Family Welfare Office Building, Ekminar Road, Raichur, Dist: Raichur-584101. 5. Joint Director (Regulatory Compliance) Food Safety And Standards Authority Of Indian, Regulatory Compliance Division, Fda Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi-100 002. ...Respondents (By Sri Veeranagouda Malipatil, Hcgp) This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226 And 227 Of The Constitution Of India, Praying To Issue A Writ Of Certiorari, Quashing The Impugned Notice Dated 27.07.2019 In No. JKJJ/g/09/2019-20, Issued By The 4Th Respondent Insofar It Relates To The Petitioner'S Unit Vide Annexure-F To This Writ Petition And Issue A Writ Of Mandamus, Directing The 4Th Respondent To Not To Seize Unit And Not To Restrict The Supply Of Water Through Water Vending Machine Of The Petitioner'S Unit. -3- Nc: 2024:Khc-K:2641 Wp No. 204612 of 2019 This Writ Petition Coming On For Preliminary Hearing In 'B' Group, This Day, The Court Made The Rajaraddy S/O Subbaraddy vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 28 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81668359/ 2 Following: Order Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo for withdrawal of the petition stating that the prayer made in the writ petition has become infructuous.
